elements.note: The wall-split arrangement: fan coil under the ceiling, refrigerant pair and drain through SLEEVES in the wall, condensing unit outside on a support with vibration isolators, drain to the main.
elements.element_name_assigned: INSTALLATION OF AIR CONDITIONER (WALL MOUNTED TYPE)

elements.note: The vertical refrigerant run is boxed in a PVC PIPE COVER with its own clips, elbows and end caps -- M-01 note 2 requires it on every vertical run. It is a proprietary trunking system, a real quantity, and it appears on no other sheet.

*** THE CONDENSING-UNIT STAND IS FULLY SPECIFIED HERE AND NOWHERE ELSE: angle-steel frame 15 cm high on four feet with 1"-thick vibration isolators under the unit. *** Five of them are needed, one per condensing unit.
elements.element_name_assigned: CONDENSING UNIT (แท่นรองรับ)

elements.note: Supply comes in at 220/1/50 through a breaker and cable 'SEE SCHEDULE' (M-01), reaches the indoor fan coil, then passes through a SAFETY SWITCH rated 20-40 A on the outdoor side before the condensing unit.
M-01 note 2 requires a weatherproof disconnecting switch beside EVERY condensing unit, so five are needed. The count is inferred from the unit count, not printed.

warnings: *** LAST SHEET OF THE WHOLE 68-SHEET DRAWING SET (M-04 of 4, after A-01..A-31, S-01..S-17, SN-01..SN-10, EE-01..EE-06). *** Four installation details for the air-conditioning system.

*** THREE COUNTABLE ITEMS ARE SPECIFIED ONLY HERE and would be missed by anyone taking off from the plans and schedules alone: the angle-steel condensing-unit stand (15 cm high with 1"-thick vibration isolators), the PVC PIPE COVER trunking on every vertical refrigerant run, and the 20-40 A weatherproof safety switch beside each condensing unit. Five of each are needed. ***
The safety-switch count is INFERRED from the five condensing units via M-01 note 2 ('ติดตั้งสวิตช์ตัดตอนชนิดกันน้ำ ... แต่ละเครื่อง'), not printed anywhere; flagged count_inferred_from_unit_count.

THE WIRING DIAGRAM DEFERS ITS TWO KEY VALUES BACK TO M-01 ('CB. SEE SCHEDULE', 'WIRE SEE SCHEDULE'), so the sheet cannot be priced on its own -- but it does print the general case, 2-2.5 + G-2.5 IEC 01 in ø1/2" EMT at 220/1/50.

NOTE THE CONDUIT MATERIAL AGAIN: EMT here and on M-01's fan note, PVC on every electrical sheet. The two disciplines specify different conduit for work that meets at the same consumer unit. Recorded as printed on each; not reconciled by either.
SLEEVES through the wall for the refrigerant pair and drain are drawn but not sized.
